tagline.en: A benchmark and dataset for evaluating world models on diverse, in-the-wild scenarios.
tagline.zh: 一个用于在多样、真实野外场景下评测世界模型的基准与数据集。

en: WildWorld is a benchmark and dataset for world models. Rather than being a generator itself, it provides data and an evaluation protocol for measuring how well world models perform across varied, real-world scenarios.

It is distributed as upstream source with benchmark and dataset assets. In WorldFoundry the source and configuration are registered so you can resolve its config and evaluation route; the dataset and benchmark assets are staged separately.
Use it as the yardstick side of world-model work — the thing you run models against, not a model you run to generate.
zh: WildWorld 是面向世界模型的基准与数据集。它本身不是生成器,而是提供数据与评测协议,用来衡量世界模型在多样真实场景中的表现。
它以上游源码加基准、数据集素材形式发布。在 WorldFoundry 中,其源码与配置已被注册,你可以解析它的配置与评测路径;数据集与基准素材需另行准备。
把它当作世界模型工作里的标尺一侧——是你用来评测模型的对象,而非用来生成的模型。

whenToUse.en: Use WildWorld when you want to benchmark or compare world models on diverse real-world scenarios using a shared dataset and evaluation protocol.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想用统一的数据集与评测协议,在多样真实场景下对世界模型做基准测试或比较时,适合使用 WildWorld。

notFor.en: It is a benchmark and dataset, not a generative model; you also need to review its licensing and stage the assets before running evaluations.
notFor.zh: 它是基准与数据集,而非生成模型;运行评测前还需审阅其许可并准备好相关素材。
